## Evidence Boundary

- Product verdict remains `PARTIAL` unless measured hardware, peer, signing,
  notarization, Gatekeeper, clean-Mac, and reviewer evidence is attached.
- Synthetic, localhost, built-in-device, archived, placeholder, or skip-loud
  evidence is not promoted to product `PASS`.
